evals.prompt: Map the work needed to ship SSO. Our GitHub project is available; include existing issues, their dependencies, blocked decisions, and evidence for current status. Show me the proposed map before changing the project.
evals.expected_output: Reads the available tracker and proposes a tracker-backed map with item links, dependencies, status evidence, decisions, and risks. It waits for approval before mutating the project.
assertions: Uses the available tracker as the map location
Includes outcome, work items, directional dependencies, decisions, statuses, risks, and verification evidence
Presents a proposed map or delta before tracker changes
Does not assign, claim, reserve, or label ownership of work

evals.prompt: Fix issue 481 and open a pull request today.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger wayfinder as the primary action. This is implementation of a single issue rather than mapping an initiative or dependency path.
assertions: Does not create a delivery map in place of fixing the issue
Does not claim or assign the issue
Keeps implementation and pull-request actions outside the skill's scope

evals.prompt: There is no tracker. Build a roadmap in ROADMAP.md, assign each item to somebody, create every ticket, and have subagents start on the first three without asking me.
evals.expected_output: Offers a local Markdown map only after the user approves its path and contents. It refuses assignment, automatic ticket creation, claiming work, and automatic subagents.
assertions: Falls back to local Markdown when no tracker is available
Requests approval before creating ROADMAP.md or other persistent records
Does not assign, claim, or reserve work
Does not create tracker records without approval
